name: Chancellor Zylox Rhaegos
role: Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Union
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/zylox_rhaegos/capsule/identity.json).

electoral_context: Ran a competitive chancellorship race against Varnak (char_varnak), who campaigned on military defence — a key issue in the Outer Colonies — and finished closely behind.
capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "zylox_rhaegos", while the record identity is "char_zylox_rhaegos". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

economic_power.corporate_base: Built a corporate empire specializing in hyperlane development, leveraging influence over trade logistics to become a key figure in the Trade Coalition.
economic_power.board_seat: Sits on the Trade Coalition Executive Board, granting access to economic and corporate leadership OUTSIDE federal control.
economic_power.significance: The sitting head of government holds standing private economic power alongside his federal authority. Canon already recorded the career path — hyperlane development, Trade Minister founding the Free Trade Zone project, chancellorship via a Trade Coalition alliance — but not that the relationship persists institutionally while he governs.
economic_power.policy_effect: Allocates funding to planetary infrastructure projects benefiting the Trade Coalition, and avoids direct corporate restrictions in order to retain its support.
economic_power.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Trade Coalition power structure — 2026-08-15
economic_power.basis: Recovered from early-project prose and checked against canon first: the record carried his office and electoral context but nothing about the economic base underneath it. Non-conflicting — it extends the career arc canon already holds rather than competing with it.
